_comment: Featured repos, in README order. Star/fork/language come live from the API on every run; the description here overrides the repo's GitHub description (all four of these currently have none set). Setting them on GitHub too is worth doing - it helps anyone browsing your repo list.

projects.description: An immersive design-engineering portfolio. Fluid scroll inertia, geometric morphing, and typography that bends toward your cursor.
A local-first calendar that shapes your week around six productivity frameworks, with an assistant that plans according to the method you pick.
A gamified operating system for your life. Goals as interactive orbits, habit and mood tracking, and Gemini breaking objectives into daily tasks.
Learn by teaching. Explain a concept to the AI, get caught on the parts you only half-understand, and prove you actually know it.
